meta.title: Clothes, shoes, bags, watches and jewelry from makers' own Shopify stores: US, GB, IE, CA
meta.priceBasis: price = the regular price on the maker's own storefront for that market (its compare-at price where a sale shows one; salePrice the sale's): US and CA before sales tax, GB and IE with VAT.
meta.confirmedMeaning: true throughout: each product read from the store's own catalog JSON (/products.json), its sizes and colors its options' values, its material where its text gives a composition that adds to a whole, its care where its text names one.
meta.method: Each maker's storefront for a market is the one its homepage's hreflang links name, its currency confirmed by its cart (/cart.js); a base store in pounds is Britain's, in Canadian dollars Canada's, and a euro one Ireland's only where the store names it for Ireland. Its garments are those its title (or, where the title names no kind, its product type) puts in a kind it was read for, a child's left out; up to 12 a kind, a product type at a time, chosen in its first market and sold under the same names in its others where they're listed. Its terms aren't read: its refund and shipping policy pages (/policies/) answered every automated read with Access Denied, so its returns window, delivery fee and days are null here.
